The '''Tchines''', also known as the '''Seven Sisters''', was a set of seven valuable statues.

==Description==
The Tchines were a set of seven thirty-[[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] statues that were sculpted from a unique type of tough [[Color/Legends|gray]] stone, and all of the figurines were identical. They were considered highly desirable by collectors of rare artifacts and during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the statues had a market prices of about 40 or 50 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==History==
The Tchines were created by a skilled artisan, but their exact origins were unknown to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. They were discovered about three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and were subsequently traded among the galactic elite, become considered rare and valuable items. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], three Tchines were kept on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], while one was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] and another one was situated on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The remaining two were kept on the planet [[Danteel]], where one was owned by the financier [[Veilred Jydor]], while the other formed part of the collection of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Carisica Vanq]]. The [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Nintellor]] owned a Tchine and once staked it along with half of his collection during a gambling tournament, although he was subsequently able to win the statue back.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Veilred Jydor decided to offer his Tchine statue as the prize for a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament that he was holding in the [[High Card Casino]] on the planet [[Danteel]], and the chance of winning such a rare artifact generated a large amount of interest in the tournament.
